C0916.title: 12 Billion Yuan Cryptocurrency Money Laundering Case: Tongliao Police Dismantle Cross-Border Money Laundering Gang
C0916.summary: Starting in May 2021, a gang led by Ji, Zhang, and Wang used Telegram to recruit downstream members, converting illicit funds from online pyramid schemes, fraud, and gambling into the stablecoin Tether (USDT) via the Tron and Ethereum blockchains, then used recruited members' anonymous blockchain accounts to exchange for RMB to pay upstream crime bosses, profiting illegally. From September to October 2022, the Tongliao Public Security Bureau's Ke'erqin Branch deployed 230 officers across 17 provinces to take down the gang, arresting 63 people; the gang laundered 120 billion yuan, with about 130 million yuan in illegal gains confiscated.
